deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

enabled.description: If this config allows users to sign in with the provider.

name.description:
The name of the InboundSamlConfig resource. Must start with 'saml.' and can only have alphanumeric characters,
hyphens, underscores or periods. The part after 'saml.' must also start with a lowercase letter, end with an
alphanumeric character, and have at least 2 characters.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

tenant.description: The name of the tenant where this inbound SAML config resource exists

idp_config.description: SAML IdP configuration when the project acts as the relying party

idp_config.idp_entity_id.description: Unique identifier for all SAML entities

idp_config.sign_request.description: Indicates if outbounding SAMLRequest should be signed.

idp_config.sso_url.description: URL to send Authentication request to.

idp_config.idp_certificates.description: The IDP's certificate data to verify the signature in the SAMLResponse issued by the IDP.

sp_config.description:
SAML SP (Service Provider) configuration when the project acts as the relying party to receive
and accept an authentication assertion issued by a SAML identity provider.

sp_config.callback_uri.description: Callback URI where responses from IDP are handled. Must start with 'https://'.

sp_config.sp_entity_id.description: Unique identifier for all SAML entities.
